pull.title: fix(tui): restore native chat scrolling and slash dispatch
pull.body:
## What

- Remove main-chat mouse capture, physical click/hover routing, Ctrl+Up/Down interception, and the custom transcript scroll view. Normal chat scrolling and selection belong to the terminal, including while notifications are live.
- Keep independent bash scrolling in its fullscreen `/jobs follow` view; add wheel scrolling, viewed-session bash job ID completions, and read-only follow dispatch from focused subagent views.
- Repair multi-word completions and missing `collab start` / `skills help` metadata. Known builtins with unsupported arguments show local usage rather than becoming chat; unknown-command dispatch and intentional prompt-returning commands stay unchanged.
- Update existing interaction and slash-command docs; preserve native/TSP semantic actions and background-card updates.

## Why

The requested behavior is terminal-owned main-chat scrolling, not another wheel workaround. Slash commands also advertised forms that their dispatcher rejected and stopped offering completions after the first word.

## Testing

- Integrated regression run: 500 passed, 0 failed, 2088 assertions across 51 files, including background-card/history retirement regressions and preserved reasoning-stream changes from current integration. The orphaned-stream fixture now supplies the required stream-event metadata; no production fallback was added.
- Actual source CLI: normal-buffer mouse flags off with the existing user configuration; `/jobs f` and `/memory mm h` displayed completions; `/jobs follow missing` and `/settings unexpected` produced local diagnostics, not chat turns.
- Real PTY production Composer, AgentSession, AsyncJobManager, BashTool and command handler: native scrollback moved 36→72 with capture off; fullscreen wheel moved the output and paused following; Escape restored the unchanged draft and kept the real job running.
- Focused real-session PTY: submitted `/jobs follow bg_1` through the enabled editor and InputController; the worker-owned bash job opened fullscreen with live output and mouse capture. Regression failed before the focused admission fix and passes afterward.
- Two read-only scoped reviews completed; the focused-view admission finding was corrected and re-reviewed with no remaining actionable findings.
- Final integrated `bun run check:ts` passed: lint, formatting, and all workspace no-emit type checks. No native or shipping builds were run locally.
- Source PR gate 160 passed for 8a6bac92e50352419f4df7e6d8ed9f78a27e96fd: lint/format/all workspace types, Rust checks, web build, native-addon and CLI builds, and compiled exact-version assertion. PR merged as 4de652557a3691df5991c00672828684c818a0ea; merged-source gate 163 and signed Arch pipeline 222 are queued. Dispatch pins the merged source, recipe 8a6eb2b8b4d1b82d34ac94b26c36e5d46cff8cd2, and oh-my-pi-vith-git. Fork CI test execution remains disabled by existing policy; checks/build success is not a test-suite result.
- No changelog requested; none changed. User configuration and running user session were not changed or restarted.

---

- [x] `bun check` passes
- [x] Tested locally
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated with the required attribution (if user-facing; internal issue fixes use issue links, external contributions add the PR link and contributor credit after creation)
